title: Vesper and the Yearbook
author: Jude Ishikawa
blurb: Sable Iversen, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
